payload.title: claude -p never answers on this host under the user's settings
payload.body: On this host `claude -p --model haiku` prints nothing for 60 s and more with the user's ~/.claude/settings.json, and answers in 2 to 5 s with --setting-sources '' or with a HOME whose settings.json is {}. The hooks in settings.json are not the cause (settings without them hang the same); enabledPlugins, env or another key is. So the default judge backend of stance-judge.sh cannot answer on this host and every Claude Code guard here goes dark whatever the payload size. Seen while measuring judgement-fits-time; its Claude Code time criterion was measured under a clean HOME (11 to 20 s on the 200000-byte turn, verdict PASS). Not bisected further; whether the judge call should skip user settings (--setting-sources '') is a design question for the judge backend.
